title: system.describe spec
description: What a system.describe request asks for: the system the engine built for the case, re-read from the engine's own model, with the sag of every surface at the given fractions of its nominal semi-diameter. Code checks that the fractions ascend.

sagFractions.description: Fractions of each surface's nominal semi-diameter at which its sag is evaluated, ascending. Without it: the nine fractions 0, 1/8, ..., 1.
